name: fs
doc: File-system paths and operations: existence, directories, copying, renaming, metadata.

items.name: ErrNotFound
items.doc: ErrNotFound is wrapped by every error about a missing file or directory (`errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotFound)`).
items.summary: ErrNotFound is wrapped by every error about a missing file or directory (`errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotFound)`).

items.name: Abs
items.doc: Abs returns an absolute representation of path.
items.summary: Abs returns an absolute representation of path.

items.name: AppendFile
items.signature: func AppendFile(path string, data string) void!
items.doc: AppendFile appends data to the file at path, creating it if needed.
items.summary: AppendFile appends data to the file at path, creating it if needed.

items.name: Base
items.doc: Base returns the last element of path.
items.summary: Base returns the last element of path.

items.name: Copy
items.signature: func Copy(from string, to string) void!
items.doc: Copy copies the file from to to.
items.summary: Copy copies the file from to to.

items.name: Dir
items.doc: Dir returns all but the last element of path.
items.summary: Dir returns all but the last element of path.

items.name: Exists
items.doc: Exists reports whether a file or directory exists at path.
items.summary: Exists reports whether a file or directory exists at path.

items.name: Ext
items.doc: Ext returns the file name extension of path, with the dot.
items.summary: Ext returns the file name extension of path, with the dot.

items.name: IsDir
items.doc: IsDir reports whether path is a directory.
items.summary: IsDir reports whether path is a directory.

items.name: Join
items.signature: func Join(a string, b string) string
items.doc: Join joins two path elements with a separator.
items.summary: Join joins two path elements with a separator.

examples.name: ExampleJoin
examples.code:
var p = fs.Join("logs", "app.log")
println(p, fs.Base(p), fs.Ext(p), fs.Dir(p))

items.name: MkdirAll
items.doc: MkdirAll creates directory path and any missing parents.
items.summary: MkdirAll creates directory path and any missing parents.

items.name: ModTime
items.doc: ModTime returns the modification time of path in Unix milliseconds.
items.summary: ModTime returns the modification time of path in Unix milliseconds.

items.name: ReadDir
items.doc: ReadDir returns the sorted names of the entries of directory path.
items.summary: ReadDir returns the sorted names of the entries of directory path.

examples.name: ExampleReadDir

items.name: Remove
items.doc: Remove removes a file or an empty directory.
items.summary: Remove removes a file or an empty directory.

items.name: RemoveAll
items.doc: RemoveAll removes path and everything it contains.
items.summary: RemoveAll removes path and everything it contains.

items.name: Rename
items.signature: func Rename(from string, to string) void!

items.name: Size
items.doc: Size returns the size of the file at path in bytes.
items.summary: Size returns the size of the file at path in bytes.

items.name: TempDir
items.doc: TempDir returns the directory for temporary files.
items.summary: TempDir returns the directory for temporary files.
